## User and workflow

Describe the role, problem and expected outcome.

## Evidence

Mark as live observation, reference, vendor claim or proposal. Use synthetic examples only.

## Acceptance conditions

Include API/MCP parity, permissions, failure/retry behavior, audit and export needs.

## Dependencies and unknowns

Do not upload PHI, credentials, private account URLs or production exports.
